title: Workplan document, schemaVersion 2
description: Primary plan JSON stored at .opencode/workplan/<id>.json. This schema is the compatible DECODING contract: it is intentionally permissive (drafts with empty phases, blank strings and missing action/validation decode). Executable-structure rules are listed in x-shiori-structure-rules and are checked separately.

planFile.description: Linked Markdown path, normally project-relative under .opencode/workplan/. Legacy './'-prefixed or absolute in-root values decode and are normalized in memory only.

specFiles.description: OPTIONAL legacy-absent field. Absence must round-trip: a document without the key keeps it absent on unrelated writes.

createdAt.description: Decoded as any string; ISO validity is a structure rule.

updatedAt.description: Decoded as any string; ISO validity is a structure rule.

x-shiori-preserve-unknown: Unknown keys at document, phase, step and finding level MUST be preserved (values and nesting). See docs/contracts.md section 'Unknown-field preservation' for the frozen policy on key order, duplicate keys and number spelling, where the reference implementation is lossy.
x-shiori-structure-rules: id: Does not match filename id <normalized>
phases: At least one phase is required
phases.<i>.steps: At least one step is required
phases.<i>.steps.<j>.id: Duplicate step id <id> in phase <phaseId>

id.description: Unique within the plan (structure rule, not a decoding rule).
Unique within its phase only; identity is (phaseId, stepId).
